matches.description: Watch Hradec Králové vs Besiktas highlights and goals from UEFA Europa League on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 6, 2026. The UEFA Europa League clash on August 6, 2026 , between Hradec Králové and Besiktas was a masterclass in resilience and tactical adaptation. Both sides entered the fray with high ambitions, resulting in a physical encounter where discipline—or the lack of it—ultimately dictated the narrative. A Cagey Opening Period The match ignited early as the referee established a strict boundary for physical play. Mick van Buren was the first to enter the book for Hradec Králové in just the 2nd minute. The home side struggled to find their rhythm under the pressure, picking up further yellow cards through Jakub Uhrincat and Vaclav Cerny as the first half progressed. Despite the stop-start nature of the game caused by frequent fouls, neither side could find the clinical edge required to break the deadlock before the interval. Red Card Drama and the Breakthrough The complexion of the game shifted dramatically in the second half. Besiktas defender Kassoum Ouattara , having already been cautioned in the 65th minute, received a second yellow card and was sent off in the 72nd minute. Down to ten men, the Turkish giants looked to be in trouble, but tactical substitutions proved inspired. The introduction of Wilfred Ndidi and Semih Kilicsoy injected fresh energy into the side at exactly the right moment. In the 80th minute, the breakthrough arrived. Wilfred Ndidi turned provider, delivering a pinpoint assist for Semih Kilicsoy , who kept his composure to fire Besiktas into the lead. Hradec Králové pushed for an equalizer in the dying stages, introducing Daniel Trubac to bolster the attack, but the ten men of Besiktas held firm. Following five minutes of added time, the final whistle confirmed a gritty away victory for the visitors.
